semiconductor_relevance: High — VFtech manufactures specialized equipment for cleanroom environments and vacuum applications critical to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai VFtech Vacuum Technology Co., Ltd specializes in the development and manufacturing of corrugated metal hose assemblies and cleanroom piping systems, which are essential for maintaining ultra-high cleanliness in semiconductor fabrication. Their products support various applications, including pressure-resistant metal hoses and automated welding processes, ensuring safety and quality in semiconductor production environments.
capabilities: Corrugated metal hose assemblies for vacuum applications

regional_presence.China: The company has established a factory in the Zhejiang Jiashan Zhongneng Environmental Protection Industrial Park, focusing on ultra-high cleanliness product production.
